purpose: Repo-local OS Abyss artifact bundle input for the playbook registry and playbook-owned generated readouts.

consumer_contract.stable_interface: python scripts/validate_abyss_machine_playbook_bundle.py --json and abyss-machine artifacts trust-gate --artifact-class playbook_registry_bundle --consumer-intent agent --json
consumer_contract.consumer_expectation: Playbook consumers select a playbook_registry_bundle from the registry latest read-model only after ABI verification, SLSA/in-toto provenance, durable evidence promotion, materialized subject-store verification, validate_playbooks, generated parity, and owner-boundary checks pass.

consumer_command: abyss-machine artifacts evidence-promote BUNDLE_DIR --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --lifecycle-state release-ready --consumer-ref aoa-playbooks:playbook-registry --evidence-ref BUNDLE_DIR/artifact.verify.json --source-repo aoa-playbooks --source-ref docs/artifact-bundles/playbook_registry.bundle.json --producer aoa-playbooks-playbook-registry-generator --trust-root-mode host_managed --json

abyss-machine artifacts materialize-subjects BUNDLE_DIR --store-root SUBJECT_STORE_ROOT --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --manifest docs/artifact-bundles/playbook_registry.bundle.json --consumer-intent agent --source-repo aoa-playbooks --trust-root-mode host_managed --json
abyss-machine artifacts trust-gate --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class playbook_registry_bundle --consumer-intent agent --source-repo aoa-playbooks --trust-root-mode host_managed --json
abyss-machine artifacts registry-latest --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class playbook_registry_bundle --consumer-intent agent --source-repo aoa-playbooks --trust-root-mode host_managed --json
